newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet in talks with Serbia but no details.
newsitem.headline: Stet in talks with Serbia but no details.

text.p: Italian state telecommunications holding Stet confirmed on Tuesday it was in contact with Serbia, following newspaper reports of a potential deal between the two parties, but declined to give details of possible negotiations.
A Stet spokesman said contact existed between the two sides but gave no details.

Il Sole financial daily said on Sunday Stet and state operator Telecom Italia, with which it is due to merge, were in negotiations with Serbia to update its telephone network and manage its telephone service.
The Financial Times, citing Serbian officials, said on Tuesday Stet was expected to buy a 49 percent stake in Serbia's state telephone company for somewhere between $610 million and $900 million.
